name: coeff_isUnit
statement: p.IsUnitTrinomial) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∈ p.support) : IsUnit (p.coeff k)

have_tree.body: support_trinomial' k m n (u : ℤ) v w hk

name: irreducible_aux1
statement: ℕ} (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (u v w : Units ℤ) (hp : p = trinomial k m n (u : ℤ) v w) : C (v : ℤ) * (C (u : ℤ) * X ^ (m + n) + C (w : ℤ) * X ^ (n - m + k + n)) = ⟨Finsupp.filter (· ∈ Set.Ioo (k + n) (n + n)) (p * p.mirror).toFinsupp⟩

name: irreducible_aux3
statement: ℕ} (hkm : k < m) (hmn : m < n) (hkm' : k < m') (hmn' : m' < n) (u v w x z : Units ℤ) (hp : p = trinomial k m n (u : ℤ) v w) (hq : q = trinomial k m' n (x : ℤ) v z) (h : p * p.mirror = q * q.mirror) : q = p ∨ q = p.mirror

name: irreducible_of_coprime
statement: p.IsUnitTrinomial) (h : IsRelPrime p p.mirror) : Irreducible p
